implementation_contract.input: a possibly empty int-valued binary tree plus a long target
implementation_contract.result: boolean existence of a root-to-leaf path whose node-value sum equals target
implementation_contract.path_semantics: root-to-leaf only; an internal prefix is not a complete path
implementation_contract.node_values: int values; negative and zero values are supported
implementation_contract.target: long to avoid constraining multi-node sums to int range

checks: int boundary sum represented by long target
5000 deterministic random trees checked against iterative root-to-leaf enumeration oracle
full tree serialization compared before and after calls to detect mutation
